nodes.description: Implement the approved Story, demonstrate RED/GREEN and simplify while green.
nodes.verify: Run related checks and record the changed files and evidence.

nodes.description: Review the final diff against the Story, including failure paths.
nodes.verify: Record findings and evidence; fail with the corrective action if changes are needed.

nodes.description: Run fresh verification after review fixes; prepare raw evidence for G4.

output.summary: Office cancel of sent team hub requests implemented (PR #21, commit d671ffb): hub link route outgoing-cancel scoped to (member, origin repo) calling the existing cancel; gateway cancel + Decisions option 2; local API with CSRF; card ✕ and Decisions in-page confirmation; plus, on user request after the real check found native dialogs suppressed in the in-app browser, all Office UI confirm/alert replaced by a shared DialogProvider. TDD per task (subagent-driven). root 590/590, typecheck 0, build 0, vendor 151/153 (2 pre-existing sprite-avatar), tsc app/node 0.

Per-task reviews (opus for hub/gateway/local API and the dialog replacement) and a final whole-branch review (opus) incl. token scope, old-hub 404 vs scope 404, CSRF before hub call, no confirm bypass, record-after-hub-success: Critical 0, Important 0; minors folded. Post-review real-check defect (suppressed confirm) fixed and re-reviewed; Task 4b Important (vacuous cancel assertions) fixed with a mutation check. Parked minors listed in the verification doc.

Fresh verification 2026-10-14 on tree 84cca41 (= commit d671ffb): npm test 590/590, typecheck 0, build:office 0, vendor vitest 151/153 (2 pre-existing), tsc app/node 0, native dialog grep 0 outside comments, Story/Task checkers exit 0. Real two-Office check: (a) accepted request cancelled from Decisions (in another browser after the in-app browser suppressed confirm) -> hub cancelled, assignee task cancelled, sender record cancelled; (b) open request cancelled from the card ✕ -> hub and record cancelled. Unproven: other PCs, company IT policy, questions/planning-retry cancel and old-hub cancel in real use, in-page dialogs of other screens in a real browser.
